lines: Don’t say you want to die.
Don’t give up—keep living.
It’s absurd to think that kind of song is right.
In truth, I wouldn’t mind dying.
I’d be sad if those around me died.
It’s an ego that says, “I hate that.”
I don’t care when others live.
Hating someone is just a fashion.
And yet we say, “Let’s live in peace.”
It sounds wonderful, doesn’t it?
Somewhere on a screen someone dies.
Someone mourns and sings about it.
A boy, influenced by that, grabs a knife and runs.
We are hated by life itself.
We force our values and egos on others.
We always stream songs that want to kill someone.
We broadcast them easily over the airwaves.
We are hated by life itself.
We speak of wanting to die lightly.
We watch life lightly, and we are hated by life itself.
With no money, I spend the whole day luxuriating in lazy sleep.
I can’t find any meaning in living.
I breathe, aware of the waste.
Can a word like “lonely” truly describe this wound?
Clinging to that stubborn pride, I lie alone in bed again today.
We who were boys will someday become youths.
Then we’ll age and turn to withered leaves.
We’ll decay unnoticed by anyone.
We obtain an invincible body.
And live a lifetime without ever dying.
We imagine such sci‑fi fantasies.
I wouldn’t care even if I died.
Yet I want those around me to keep living.
Living with that contradiction only brings scolding.
“Do what’s right, and be right.”
“If you don’t want to die, keep living.”
If becoming sad is all that’s left, that’s fine too.
Just keep laughing alone forever.
We are hated by life itself.
We don’t even understand the meaning of happiness.
We only hate the circumstances of our birth.
We easily curse the past.
We are hated by life itself.
We love saying goodbye far too much.
We’ve never known a real parting, yet we are hated by life itself.
Happiness, partings, love, friendship—
All can be bought with money in a ridiculous dream’s play.
We might die tomorrow.
Everything might become pointless.
Morning and night, spring and autumn,
Someone, somewhere keeps dying unchanged.
We need no dreams, no tomorrow, nothing at all.
If you are alive, that’s enough.
Yes, that’s really what I want to sing about.
Hated by life.
In the end we’ll all eventually die.
You and I will both wither like fallen leaves.
And yet we desperately keep living.
We cling to life with desperate hands.
Kill, struggle, laugh, hold on.
Live, live, live, live, live.
